title.purpose: Workflow stages and major result regions.

label.purpose: Persistent field labels and action text.

motion.name: reduced-scroll
motion.purpose: Removes smooth scrolling when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Advances the student to the next workflow stage.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 20px; color: #fff; background: var(--blue, #2457d6); border: 0; border-radius: 5px; font: 760 16px/1.5 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--blue-dark, #1947b8); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8ba7f5; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #153c9c; }

components.name: Text Button
components.description: Adds another item without competing with the stage action.
components.css: .ds-btn-text { min-height: 44px; padding: 0; color: var(--blue, #2457d6); background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; font: 750 16px/1.5 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-text:hover { color: var(--blue-dark, #1947b8); } .ds-btn-text:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8ba7f5; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-text:active { color: #153c9c; }

components.name: Course Input
components.description: A persistent-label field for course identity.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: var(--ink, #132b3d); font: 720 14px/1.4 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 13px; color: var(--ink, #132b3d); background: #fff; border: 1px solid #b9c5cc; border-radius: 5px; font: 400 16px/1.5 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #8a9aa4; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8ba7f5; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-field span { color: var(--muted, #637481); font: 400 12px/1.5 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Course Upload Area
components.description: Keeps a multi-image upload visibly owned by one entered course.
components.html: Course 1CMPS 251Programming Concepts
components.css: .ds-upload { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 160px 1fr; min-height: 130px; color: var(--ink, #132b3d); background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d5dde2); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-upload-name { display: grid; align-content: center; gap: 4px; padding: 20px; border-right: 1px solid var(--line, #d5dde2); } .ds-upload-name small, .ds-upload-name span, .ds-drop span { color: var(--muted, #637481); font-size: 12px; } .ds-drop { display: grid; align-content: center; gap: 4px; margin: 12px; padding: 20px; border: 2px dashed #b5c1c8; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-drop:hover { border-color: var(--blue, #2457d6); background: #fbfcff; } .ds-drop:focus-within { outline: 3px solid #8ba7f5; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-drop input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; opacity: 0; }

components.name: Selected Schedule Option
components.description: A compact, text-led selection state for generated schedules.
components.css: .ds-schedule { width: 100%; display: grid; gap: 2px; padding: 12px 14px; color: var(--ink, #132b3d); background: var(--blue-soft, #e9efff); border: 2px solid var(--blue, #2457d6); border-radius: 5px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-schedule strong { font-size: 16px; } .ds-schedule span { color: var(--muted, #637481); font-size: 12px; } .ds-schedule:hover { background: #dde7ff; } .ds-schedule:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8ba7f5; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-schedule:active { background: #d3dfff; }

components.name: Privacy Notice
components.description: Places privacy instructions before the first upload action.
components.html: Hide your name, student ID, and email before uploading.
components.css: .ds-privacy { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; padding: 13px 15px; color: #335f56; background: var(--green-soft, #e1f3ed); font: 400 13px/1.5 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-privacy svg { width: 18px; flex: none; margin-top: 1px; }

narrative.overview:
The interface is a quiet, precise, trustworthy academic workspace. It should feel like a clear desk prepared for one consequential task: translating a student's own PeopleSoft evidence into schedules they can inspect and trust. Alignment, restrained color, and timetable geometry provide structure; decoration never competes with course data.

The experience is sequential rather than dashboard-driven. It moves from courses to screenshots to verification and schedules, with every screenshot and generated meeting visibly tied back to the course the student supplied. It explicitly rejects playful consumer-app styling and dense admin-dashboard composition.
keyCharacteristics: Formal and institutional without becoming bureaucratic.
Sequential, focused, and explicit about provenance.
Flat, bordered work surfaces with compact controls.
Familiar browser affordances and visible state changes.
Responsive structure from narrow mobile screens to desktop.

rules.name: The One-Action Rule
rules.body: Institutional Blue identifies action or state. It must never become general decoration.

rules.name: The Semantic Pairing Rule
rules.body: Green, gold, and blue states always include readable text, labels, or geometry; color alone never communicates meaning.

rules.name: The Data Legibility Rule
rules.body: Course codes, class numbers, dates, statuses, and times must remain plainly readable. Never trade legibility for visual personality.

rules.name: The Single-Family Rule
rules.body: UI labels, buttons, and course data always use the product sans stack; display or decorative fonts are forbidden.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: A surface must earn separation through task grouping before receiving a border. Decorative shadows and glass effects are forbidden.

dos: Do ask for course identities before presenting course-specific upload controls.
Do allow multiple screenshots within every course upload area and keep each image associated with its course.
Do reserve Institutional Blue for primary actions, current steps, focus, and selected states.
Do preserve explicit text for Open, Wait List, Closed, conflict-free, and bundled-component states.
Do use persistent labels, visible keyboard focus, semantic HTML, and practical touch targets.
Do keep the workflow structurally readable from 320px mobile widths through desktop.
Do use one consistent component vocabulary across courses, screenshots, verification, and schedules.
donts: Don't invent courses, sections, meetings, instructors, or results that the student did not supply.
Don't make the product resemble playful consumer apps with gamification, decorative illustrations, or casual visual language.
Don't use dense admin dashboards dominated by sidebars, metric cards, and unrelated system information.
Don't wrap every region in a rounded card or add decorative shadows, gradients, glass effects, or ornamental motion.
Don't encode course identity, registration status, or schedule validity with color alone.
Don't use display fonts in labels, buttons, or course data, or reinvent familiar form controls for flavor.
Don't use modals where inline disclosure or the next sequential stage can complete the task.
